events.name: The Final Choice
events.intro: The upper deck of Aether Paradise. The sky coming apart like wet paper. Pale bells drifting in it. Walking toward it: Lusamine, in white, not hurrying. Behind her, for once not in front of anyone: Guzma. A bat. No bandana: she's asked him to take it off. At the rail: Lillie, with a bag that's moving. At the lift: Wicke, with a pile of forms. Faba, with a key. On the dock, below: a van. Forty kids. Plumeria, with a book. Beside you: your squad. Lusamine: "It's open. Do you see them? They don't change. They don't leave. They only want." Lusamine, to Guzma, without turning: "Come along, dear. Hold the door. A kahuna keeps his island's gate." Guzma: "...Yeah." He doesn't move yet. Lusamine, to you: "And you're the one he's fond of. Bring him. He dawdles."

events.name: Phase 3: Through
events.intro: You go through with her. A sea with no water in it. Black rock. Glass threads. A hundred pale bells. Lusamine: "There. Do you feel it? Nothing's going anywhere." One of the bells comes down. It settles on her like a hat, and then like a veil, and then there isn't a line between them. The Mother Beast, her voice and a chord under it: "Look how still they are. Look how they stay. Deputy. You'll stay." She's happy. She isn't herself. She can't be pulled out. She can be reminded.

success.text: A turn. Another. Your party's Pokémon are being put back: one by one, into their Balls, by threads. "Everything in its place."

The Mother Beast: "...Go home." The chord wavers. "That was his. I took it down. It told everything to go." You pull. It's a bar: your hand in hers. She doesn't come; but you do. The gate doesn't close cleanly. Alola has Beasts in it now: once a stage, a wild battle may be an Ultra Beast, frightened, that flees at half health. Lusamine has what stays. Aether runs itself. The cold room's still cold. Your Pokémon that were put back, on the far side, are slow to come out of their Balls for the rest of Alola; it fades. Lusamine is on the far side. Happy. Not herself. Guzma went; or turned round for forty voices. Plumeria feeds forty, still. Wicke signs intake, and nothing else. Faba is the last line. Koa holds a door he doesn't understand. The man at the Pelago hums, and doesn't know why he's sad today. Nanu feeds the cats. Po Town is forty and a bat. The sign says GET WELL.

Gladion: "You made three monsters to protect us from the thing you want to wear. I named mine."

events.name: Phase 3: Lillie
events.intro: She's beaten. The gate's still open. She could still walk. Lillie, from the rail, with a bag: Lillie: "Mother." Lusamine: "Lillie. You've done something to your hair." Lillie: "I'm going to. Next week. I've decided. I'm not perfect. I'm not finished. I'm going to change and you're going to miss it if you go in there." A long time. The bells drift. Lusamine: "...What will you do to it?" Lillie: "I don't know yet. That's the point."

success.text: It's a lever. It's heavy. Whoever's beside you helps. It shuts, with her on this side. Aether's run by Wicke, who releases things. The first is a Mareanie. The sign's put back up: the old one, off the barge, hand-lettered, both sentences. Skull's a house with forty kids and a roof that's been fixed. Nanu signs the lease, sighing. A week on, at the foot of a trial site, Koa, with thirty-nine people behind him and one in white gloves: Koa: "A'ight. Fourth time. Somebody watchin'?" All of them: "YEAH." Lusamine asks what Lillie'll do to her hair. Guzma: "Ya boy is NOT a keepsake." Plumeria runs Po Town. Wicke is President, and releases a Mareanie first. Faba is on reception, handing out the leaflet. Koa takes his trial a fourth time, and forty watch. Zia runs releases. Uri is told to let them go, and does. Lux is in school; all forty come to parents' evening. Lillie cuts her hair. Gladion is Deputy, unwillingly. Tall Tale is woken, and looks north. The man at the Pelago gets a visitor who's good at beans. Nanu signs the lease. Po Town has a roof. The sign has both sentences.

events.intro: It isn't a battle. It's a carry. Forty kids. Sixty cases. A lift that holds four. Guzma, with a case on his shoulder that's got a Pikachu in it, mid-leap: Guzma: "I ain't smashin' nothin'. Anybody smashes anything, they answer to me. These are people's." Tupp: "Yo, we're haulin' glass, don't be an—" Rapp: "Don't." Tupp: "—lass?" Zipp: "Lass!" Lux, who's been told to wait in the van, holding the lift door: Lux: "I'm helping." Route the cases to the ferry before the stasis units' batteries run down.

success.text: Each that reaches the dock is set down by the water, and opened. They wake.

failure.text: The batteries are low on the last dozen; the lift sticks twice. Every case reaches the dock in the end, slower than you'd like. Each is set down by the water, and opened. They wake.

events.intro: The last eight. Lux's is on top: "Plumes. I got everybody's. Everybody's got everybody's now."

success.text: You carry them. Forty. They've all got each other's addresses now. Months on, a van's seen on the Poni road. It's very full.
You leave them on the table at the rest. Somebody else might.

events.name: Phase 1: The Deck
events.intro: "You've each got half a good idea. You take them in. You make them well. Neither of you does the next part." Guzma: "...You want us?" Wicke: "I've the forms." Lusamine, at the gate, turning for the first time: Lusamine: "You'd take my Foundation. And put it with that." "It's your husband's Foundation. I've seen his sign."

success.text: Neither's fought to the end. Each is fought to a stop.

events.name: Phase 2: Two Bosses
events.intro: Guzma: "I been second my whole life, Number One. You tellin' me I gotta be second to you?"

choices.label: "I'm telling you there's forty-one. And you count separate."

success.text: He laughs. He sits down on the deck. Guzma: "...Plumes says that. A'ight." Lusamine is already sending out Madame.

events.name: Phase 2: Two Bosses
events.intro: Lusamine: "You'll let them go. All of them. That's what the second sentence is. You'll stand on the dock and wave."

success.text: She doesn't answer. She doesn't go through, either.
She doesn't answer. She doesn't go through, either. She looks north.

events.name: Phase 3: The First Hour
events.intro: A deck. A dock. Forty kids. Two hundred staff. Two hundred and six that got better. A gate, open. Four decisions. The first: the sign.

success.text: The sign stays as it was.
Both sentences. Everything the team takes in will have a count: days till it's somewhere to go. The team's judged on it.
You write it under the first, yourself.

events.name: Phase 3: The First Hour
events.intro: The second: the cold room.

success.text: B2 stays cold.
Sixty cases, opened one at a time, and each is asked. The police wave, these days.

choices.label: Wake them, and keep the ones that'd be useful.

success.text: A powerful roster on day one. Zia leaves the door open, and walks out through it.

events.name: Phase 3: The First Hour
events.intro: The third: the gate.

success.text: It shuts.
It stays open.

choices.label: Shut it, and keep a door: for the ones on the far side that are lost.

success.text: A door: the Thin Place. Once a stage, a frightened Beast may be shown the way back.

events.name: Phase 3: The First Hour
events.intro: The fourth: the forty.

success.text: They're Grunts.

choices.label: Each one's asked: "What's next?" And somebody watches.

success.text: Each of the forty has a trial to retake. Koa's first.

events.name: One Slowpoke
events.intro: A nursery on Akala. You walk in on a corridor. Two squads. One Slowpoke, between them, being held at both ends. Koa: "Yo. That's ours." Zia: "It's a patient." Uri: "I've been told to take it." Koa: "I been told to take it." The Slowpoke yawns. Lux, who was locked in a van: Lux: "Why's everybody got the same job?" Nobody asks how she got out. They've all noticed you.

success.text: The nursery's keeper: "Nobody's. It walked in. Two years back. It's got a friend here." Nobody lets go. You leave them to it.

choices.label: "Put it down. All of you. See where it goes."

success.text: Four hands let go. It sits. It thinks about it. It takes about a minute. It's the longest minute in the corridor's history. It gets up. It goes back into the nursery, slowly, and lies down next to another Slowpoke, which shuffles over without waking. Koa: "...So nobody needed to steal it." Zia: "Nobody needed to have it." Uri: "I wasn't told what to do if it didn't want to go. Nobody's ever covered that." Lux: "It's got a friend." Koa and Zia have met. He notices her gloves. She notices he's wet.
It's not your corridor. You leave them holding it.

events.name: Team Tidepool
events.intro: Rocks. A pool on Akala, at low water. Two people sitting on either side of it who've never sat on the same rocks. Zia Pemberton, gloves off, one hand in the water: Zia: "You said, 'See where it goes.' I've thought about nothing else." Koa Ridgeway, wet, as usual: Koa: "She wrote me. On paper. I ain't had a letter since I was eleven." Zia: "I know how to make them well." Koa: "I know what it's like when nobody wants you after." Both: "It's the same job. It's the second half nobody does." In the pool: a Corsola, with one branch shorter than the others. It's looking at Zia. It waves the branch. Zia: "...That's— I nursed that one. Before the cold. They let one go, my first year, by mistake. It came back here." She's crying. It's very undramatic. Zia: "It remembers me. It went home and it remembers me. I didn't know they did that. Nobody at the Paradise knows they do that; we've never let enough go to find out." The creed, scratched on a rock above the tide line: BETTER ISN'T FINISHED TILL YOU'VE SOMEWHERE TO GO.

success.text: You sit. Team Tidepool: Zia, who can make anything well; Koa, who knows the walk back up; Uri, who'd like to be told something he'd have done anyway. Lux isn't crew. She's fourteen. She'll be the first one Tidepool finds a place for, and she'll pick it.

Zia counts them off. Uri Vandermeer: "I do what I'm told. I'd like to be told something I'd have done anyway." Wicke: two hundred and six unsigned forms, and a boat she can borrow. Plumeria: the Borrow Book, three open entries. Nanu: he doesn't join; he stops charging rent. Acerola, eleven, who does the cooking: "I've a house full of kids with nobody. D'you want it to be part of this? It'd be nice to be part of something that writes back." And a captain, unnamed: the one who said "next." He's come to watch.

remembers.notice: Uri: "I do what I'm told. I'd like to be told something I'd have done anyway."

events.name: Return 1: Three Open Entries
events.intro: A Return's a walk. Somebody, or something, that's been taken in is taken back: to where it's from, or to where it's chosen. Tidepool goes along. It doesn't leave till the thing's landed. Plumeria opens the Borrow Book. Three hundred and twelve. Three not brought back.

success.text: You go along.

events.name: A Rockruff
events.intro: A Rockruff, from a boy on Melemele. The boy moved. Nobody knew where. Found: Akala, a new school. He doesn't recognise it at first; it's grown. It recognises him.

success.text: Plumeria ticks it.

events.name: A Cutiefly
events.intro: A Cutiefly, from a florist. It was let go by a Grunt who felt bad. In the wrong meadow. It's doing fine.

choices.label: Ask it. (An open hand; a flower.)

success.text: It goes back. The florist's kept its jar.

events.name: A Mudbray
events.intro: A Mudbray, from a farm. It doesn't want to go back. It's been pulling the Po Town taro cart for a year and it likes it. Plumeria goes to the farm herself. With the book. She apologises. The farmer: "A year? I thought it was stolen. You've been working it? ...Is it happy?"

success.text: He comes to see. It's happy. He takes a day's wage for it, and a bag of taro. Plumeria closes the book. It's the first time it's balanced.

events.name: Return 2: The Fourth Time
events.intro: A trial site. Koa takes his trial again. Koa: "Three times I walked up there. I can tell you every stone." Behind him: thirty-nine kids, a keeper in white gloves, a guard, an eleven-year-old with a ladle, and an old man under several cats. Koa: "...That's a lot of people." Zia: "You said if somebody was watching." Koa: "I said somebody."

success.text: You don't take it for him. You watch.

events.name: The Fourth Time
events.intro: You're in the crowd. It's a battle you aren't in. It goes wrong, in the middle. His Salandit's burned out. He's got one left. At the top of the path, the captain. The same one. He's not talking to anybody. He's watching. The captain: "...Take your time." It's the opposite of "next."

success.text: He passes. Forty people make a noise that the island hears. A queue's formed behind him: Nohea. The twin. The boy who froze.

failure.text: He doesn't. Koa: "A'ight. Fifth time. Tuesday?" Forty people: "TUESDAY." A queue's formed behind him: Nohea. The twin. The boy who froze.

success.text: You look at the sea. When you look back, it's over. It doesn't matter which way.

failure.text: You look at the sea. When you look back, he's at the top. A queue's formed behind him: Nohea. The twin. The boy who froze.

events.name: Return 3: Two Hundred and Six
events.intro: The conservation wing, at night. Wicke's forms. Each one's a Pokémon that got better and has been waiting. Wicke: "If I sign the other form: 'release': I need a second signature. A keeper's." Zia's got a pen. Wicke: "And a destination. For each. The form won't file without."

success.text: You start with the first pile.

events.name: Two Hundred and Six
events.intro: A long, quiet game: two hundred and six charts. Each has where it was found. You sort them by island; Tidepool's crew takes a boat each. "Mareanie. Spines regrown. Found: Hano Beach." "Wingull. Wing set. Found: off Po Town." That's where all the Wingull went. "Petilil. Found: Lush Jungle. Has asked to stay." It's allowed. That's somewhere to go. "Slowpoke. Nothing wrong. Found: a nursery. Has a friend there."

success.text: The wing's empty by morning. Curator Pua's standing in it. Pua: "It's very quiet. I'd thought— I'd thought it'd feel like losing them." She looks at the chalk on the wall: Zia's started two columns. Pua: "It feels like the job."

events.name: Still Here
events.intro: The upper deck. The gate. Lusamine, walking. Tidepool doesn't fight. It comes up the stairs with two people. Zia: "President. We've brought you something." Lusamine: "I'm leaving, dear. I'm going where nothing does." Koa: "Yeah. We heard. Thing is. You got this idea that stuff either stays the same or it's gone."

success.text: You step aside.

events.name: Still Here
events.intro: Two people step forward. Gladion, with a Pokémon that's got its helmet off, and a name. Lillie, with a bag, and a look she didn't used to have. Zia: "They changed. They're still here." Lillie: "Mother. I'm going to cut my hair." Gladion: "I named it. It's fine. We're fine. Come and see." Lusamine: "...You're not the ones I had." Lillie: "No. You never met us. You were busy keeping the others."

success.text: Somebody else is coming up.

events.name: Still Here
events.intro: Behind them, up the stairs, at their own pace: a Corsola with a short branch, carried in a bucket by a fourteen-year-old. A Pikachu, that was frozen mid-leap, finishing the leap. A Slowpoke, and its friend. Zia: "These got better. And went. And came to say so." The Corsola waves its branch. Lusamine: "It did that to him. On the barge. I never forgave it." Koa: "Lady. It's wavin' at you."

success.text: Lusamine doesn't go through the gate.
A boat's come in.

events.name: Still Here
events.intro: A man in a straw hat, with a basket, who's been told there are people here who like beans. The Man at the Pelago: "Hello, hello! What a lot of stairs! Is this the— oh." He's looking at an Exeggutor on the dock. It's looking at him. Three heads. The Man at the Pelago: "...Well, now. Don't I know you." He's humming. Lillie's humming. It's the same tune. Lusamine doesn't go through the gate. She sits down on the deck in a white dress. She doesn't tell him. She asks if she can carry the basket.

success.text: Nobody's holding it open now.

events.name: Still Here
events.intro: The gate closes by itself. Nobody was holding it open but her.

success.text: It closes. Tidepool doesn't disband. It becomes a thing Alola has: a rock by the tide with a line scratched on it, where a Pokémon may be asked what it wants. The sign's back. The sign's on the Po Town wall, in paint. Both sentences. Twice.
